title: Bluetti AC Status Weekly Input Power Trend
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bluetti:status input_w=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(input_w) as avg_duration, max(input_w) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst input power for Bluetti AC status events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture input_w on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average input power with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly whether Bluetti AC status tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
